label: A first mover moved by none that is PURE_ACT_5 and the only first unmoved mover is GOD_4, in the…
paraphrase: A first mover moved by none that is pure act and the only first unmoved mover is God, in the sense of the God of classical theism. Stronger than the nominal identification of ST I q.2 a.3 (et hoc omnes intelligunt Deum).
